info.cls_ename: College of Humanities and Social Sciences

description.describe_ch: 本課程將聚焦於臺灣傳統戲曲形式的介紹與演變，及其現代的發展與表現，包括：臺灣京劇、歌仔戲與布袋戲等。引導學生認識及了解臺灣的傳統戲曲，更進一步思考傳統文化發展與保存可能面臨到的課題。
description.describe_eh: This course aims at introducing the traditional theatrical arts in Taiwan, including their forms, styles, the development and modern expressions. Three major forms will be discussed and introduced: Beijing (Peking) Opera, Taiwanese Opera, and Taiwanese puppetry. Students will learn to understand and appreciate Taiwanese traditional arts, and further consider the challenges we are now facing when it comes to preserving and promoting traditional arts and cultures.

targets.describe_ch: 透過學習不同劇種，學生能培養對傳統戲曲之認識與欣賞能力。
targets.describe_en: Students will cultivate their familiarity with traditional theatrical arts and appreciation through the course.

targets.describe_ch: 學習從多元文化視角認識本土文化，了解文化保存與創新的重要性。
targets.describe_en: Students will learn to perceive the  local culture through multicultural perspectives and understand the importance of cultural preservation and innovation.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration. 學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
6. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
